title_original: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Decree are defined as follows: <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017>
1. "Agency personnel management system" means a system independently established by a local government to electronically process personnel affairs of the relevant agency.
2. "Standard personnel management system" means a standardized personnel management system that enables a local government to database personnel records of its public officials and electronically process personnel affairs by linking with the local personnel policy support system operated by the Minister of the Interior and Safety.
3. "Local personnel policy support system" means a system established by the Minister of the Interior and Safety to electronically receive and manage data by linking with the standard personnel management system or agency personnel management system of local governments in order to support personnel policies of local governments and electronically process their personnel affairs.
4. "Electronic personnel management system" means the overall system linking the standard personnel management system or agency personnel management system operated by local governments with the local personnel policy support system operated by the Minister of the Interior and Safety.
